SESSION_ID.description: Your session ID — the code you receive after scanning the QR code / pairing.

PREFIX.description: Command prefix (can also be changed later with .setprefix).

NUMERO_OWNER.description: Owner phone number used for protected settings commands.

PUBLIC_MODE.description: Set to on so ordinary commands work for all users; off restricts ordinary commands to owner/sudo.

PM_PERMIT.description: Set to off to allow ordinary private-chat commands from all users.

BOT_OS.description: Device profile and menu target: android by default; set ios only when explicitly needed.

AUTO_JOIN_GROUP.description: Set to on to automatically accept the configured group invite; off is safer by default.
